sn48.19:1.1: Atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || pe || Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu Bhagavantam etad avoca || 3.
sn48.19:2.2: kittāvatā nu kho bhante indriyasampanno hotīti || || 4.
sn48.19:2.3: Idha bhikkhu bhikkhu saddhindriyam bhāveti upasamagāmiṃ sambodhagāmiṃ || pe || paññindriyam bhāveti upasamagāmiṃ sambodhagāmiṃ || || 5.
sn48.19:2.4: Ettāvatā kho bhikkhu bhikkhu indriyasampanno hotīti || || 2.
